label: D-1b5088

defects.summary: Qualifying treats every undecided agy RateLimited as a gauge case, including a plain text '429 Too Many Requests' that never carried RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, so every transient agy throttle starts a /quota probe of up to 30 s before the summary.
Inside the lock, a read that fails with an IO or access error answers Empty, and the write that follows then replaces every other process's standing entries instead of refusing.
QuotaReset.NotParked uses a Parks flag with a meaningless MinValue instant and a 'guess' source; a separate result case would model 'do not park' more clearly.
The spend-limit 429 is found by checking that WhyItFailed's rendered sentence ends with '(HTTP 429)', not by reading api_error_status itself.
CooldownNotices stamps the notice with DateTimeOffset.UtcNow instead of the injected clock, and the class sits in a file named for another class.

S37 checks the refusal notice only through the onRefused callback, so PanelService's wiring to Noticing is untested; S36 also does not prove that B actually waited on the lock rather than starting late.
The fixture-loading and bucket-mutation helpers are copied between two test classes, and a new QuotaTestLog sink was added although the internal ListSink already exists.
The DeepseekRuntime override leaves two consecutive blank lines.
The DoD requires every scenario to be seen red first; deviation 12 admits several were not, and the S3 change of its Given reason is noted only in passing.

summary: This delivers all four stories faithfully: all 43 scenarios are present and pass, the build, both test suites and the format check are green, and the code does what D1–D11 ask (structured verdict, both AGY_ERROR shapes, the measured group table, the locked fail-open file, per-key aggregation, roster exclusion, wire member and card), with sound deviations recorded truthfully in §12. The findings are all minor: an eager probe on transient agy throttles, a couple of edge cases in the fail-open contract, a few indirect detections, some duplicated test helpers, and scenario reds that were not all seen first.
